verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents agents provisioning sandboxes via the Blaxel skill/SDK/MCP with zero-code prompts, executing code/processes, reading file/process/log output, and tearing down via expiration policies, archiving, or explicit deletion — all programmatically without human intervention. Every sandbox exposes an MCP server for tool-call-based operation, closing the loop end-to-end for an autonomous agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the full lifecycle (no third-party corroboration, only first-party docs).
